name: @buxo/models
description: buxo C7: the model-agnostic adapter (DF-1). Owns, PER TASK (tutor/assessor/judge/ingest/safety), which (provider, model) is used, how its correct behavior is forced, and what happens when it fails — via its OWN hand-populated capabilities registry (never the AI SDK's), never asking @ai-sdk/* 'does this model support X' (docs/LECCIONES-Y-BUGS.md 2026-07-11). Wraps the AI SDK (streamText/generateObject), doesn't replace it. No DOM, no Node-specific APIs, no imports from apps/* (same purity gate as @buxo/core and @buxo/domain). Zero network calls in this package or its tests — provider instances are always injected by the caller.
